translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Yesus kinám kukum keisa sung uta ko.
Kale am bokuw kal banimane, Yesus ayo Bita, Yemis wáw alam muk anung Yon keida nikil ilifin imadewa ki un bi tam amgu kimisung mak umi tikin kal unsiw.
Kale ika tam kal Yesus ayo atamomane, akal kinim kinám kukum keida ka, kalesiw. Ade ami kinám ayo ki atan eidin taw kei nadale alami ilim kal akal atin namal lamlam gán bi kudába ka. Kalomo,
kinim alew Mosus so Ilaitsa so kuw tad ilimi kin gubuyo kal misuna bom Yesus so weng bakabiw ka. Kale nadiwe

Bita ayo Yesus bakodaw, “Kamokim kawta, kadák ki ken bumo, kalbuw kale kalam aket so keno, kalbaw namti, ken nuka gusák am alewbino mak kufo gine naduwo mak be kami, mak be Mosus ami, mak be Ilaitsa ami audumo.”

Kal bom bakam sadane ibin kait ta be falfal namas imudane, ibin tem kaokal weng mak bako kala ka. “Bela nalam Man ade naka am aket ki atin yakabesi. Ade naka atin am idak ki teinbi. Kale kiba kidela am weng kidilaw bom nadiwo kala.” Kalesa.
Kale weng kidimin kinim iyo weng bela kidi nadiwade mikabu, bila dák bakan abe ilim kin gubu uyo kuwo bakanu nadiwade ika wadwad sawsaw bom fingániw.
Kata Yesus aka tad nadale teng dew yak maleyam nadale aka bakoyam, “kala kan todino, kiba fingánin bá.” Yaka nade
beta ika mik dakfo katam fenomo kinim banim, alam Yesus alafin tod be ka, kalesiw ko.

Kale nikil asiki kot daw kadák mo tadom nadiwe, Yesus ayo weng kidimin kinim alewbino iyo weng anuyam nadale bakoyam, “kiba kanomin kukuw utamiw be kiba kinim so mak bakayamin bá, alam kanom sading kale sidiwo Got ami Kinim ayo fikale talá tabano.” Yakeisa ko.
Kale beta weng kidimin kinim iyo dákadámin weng mak Yesus dákadálawiw. “Watawo kaleyo sawa kukumin kinim iyo bako nadiwe Ilaitsa asik gebom tadano, Walusa Kinim be yanol tadokabano kalesiwe?” Akiwe,
aka weng atung fakadu bakoyam, “au, be afan ka. Ilaitsa asik gebom tad ufek ufek adikum uyo kidelawokaba.

Kata naka dam weng bakoyamon, Ilaitsa asik gebom tase, kata wanang kinim iyo ami kin gubu uyo kidela atadawongin banim kei nadiwe ilim aket yaknodawumo, kalbiw uyo kanadawsiw. Kale leiw makuw ulutaw be ki Got ami Kinim akal kano ilim teng dim kal, kál funin kudawokabiw.” Kalane,
weng kidimin kinim iyo kal keidomo, aka Yon wok ban bomin kinim ami sung bakayaba ka. Kalesiw ko.
Yesus man kinim mát mak kidel dausa sung uta ko.
Kale ika tad wanang kinim seng itamiwe, kinim mak maek Yesus kin gubuyo kal katun katun luko dudák di tein nadale bakodaw,

“Kamokim kawta, nam man be aket budunin daudawalo! Aka madaw gam kale aka madiw madiw bom nadale kál funin dukum kuw kei bom nadale sun kuw anak weing ká bi bom nadale sun kuw anew dák wok ká bi bom keimábano,
naka dew tad kami weng kidimin kinim dáyami, kata ika kidel daudongin dakobiwo.” Akane,

Yesus aka weng atung fakadu bakoyam, “au, kiba aket afan kalongin banim ade kukuw mafak kuw keimin kinim mit kiba! Naka kiwso sun tein bokabi bá, ade naka kiwso bo dákbu bom bi am utaw kal uta keidokabinale?” Kalbane kala. “Man ayo dew tadalo!” Akeisa.
Kale beta Yesus ayo sinik mafak ngadák fuko dawtidane, sinik mafak ayo man bá dabadá yak abe kei badane, kabadákal man ayo kasása ko.
Kale weng kidimin kinim iyo ilifin gei dau nadiwe, Yesus dákadálaw, “watawo kaleyo nuka sinik mafak ayo fotabuw unoma banime?” Akiwe,

aka weng atung fakadu bakoyam, “watawo kaleyo bá, kim aket Got afan kalin uyo katiw, kayo naka atin afan dam weng bakayamon, kimi aket Got afan kalin uyo mew mada yet luw kalbiw alataw nam, bude kiba amgu bela bakomam, kadák bo kudá yak kaek unalo! Wakiw, afan kudá yak kaek abomu ade yaknámin mak kiba ken kanodoliw bá uyo ken kanamodiw ka.
Kata sinik mafak fotabamámin leiw be deng mák bá, kata be leiw makuw alam imin fale nadawe Got so weng bakanin bemi leiw kuw ka.” Yakeisa.
Kale ika tad Galili kal fabudumo nadiwe Yesus aka bakoyam, “Got ami Kinim ayo wasi gi dauyamiwe,
ika anbidiw fikalokaba ade am alewbino kei nadale aka talá tabokabano kalane, alam weng kidimin kinim iyo aket mafak mafakyamsa ko.
Yol am abem umino kale tumon takis keimin sung uta ko.

Kale Yesus so alam weng kidimin kinim so iyo tad Kabeniyam abiw tadiwe Yol am abem umino, kale tumon takis kuámin kinim iyo tad Bita atam nadiwe bakodaw, “kawta kimi Kukumin kinim ayo kisol so mak kudu Yol am sánábane?” Akiwe,

Bita ayo ami weng fakadu bakodaw, “au,” akei nadale beta wakas matam am tadane, Yesus ayo asik Bita bakodaw, “Saimon kam aket watawo kalbáwe? Mew bakan dim kamok kamok ika takis be wanang kinim madik imi dim kal kuámámaliw bude ilim muduw dim kal kuámámaliwe?” Kalane,
Bita asik yán kidaw bako nadale, “bá, ika kinim madik imiyo kal takis kuámámaliw.” Kalane, beta Yesus ayo bakodaw, “ilim muduw ika takis modongin dakoyabiw.

Kale nuka takis bo nuso sánoduw bá, kata masi nuka kudáluwe, ika kus itamodiw. Kale kaba dák wok mik kimai dawbino nadawo takam kamakikiw dabudu nadawe bon tem tako dau kalomo tumon makuw mak bu ka. Kale nadawo dew tad kalami so nami so Yol am kaw tam umi takis uyo modal kala.” Akeisa ko.
